human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Project explicit action authority facts from normalized evidence and emit deterministic authority_violation / authority_unknown governance signals without turning Ailuros into an execution orchestrator or permission platform. This closes the production-proven case where intent and diagnosis can be correct while the action targets the wrong repository/project. Dependency: 8027.document-dogfood-operations.
human_pressure.why_now: EverRun dogfood has now produced a concrete cross-project write failure: the system knew the requested project differed from the active repository, yet a repository write still occurred. Ailuros needs a source-neutral post-run representation of whether an actor was authorized for the exact action and target.
do_not_misread: This is post-run evidence governance, not a new runtime authorization API.
Do not build RBAC, IAM, tenant permissions, repository discovery, or a policy DSL.
Evidence is authoritative; missing authority evidence is unknown, never implicitly allowed.
red_lines: Do not add runtime blocking or external write capabilities.
Do not add EverRun-specific repository fields to the canonical model.
Do not infer authority from intent text, planner prose, model identity, or successful execution.

machine_core.goal: Add a minimal source-neutral AuthorityRecord projection and deterministic authority governance signals over existing normalized evidence.
red_lines: Do not add runtime blocking or external write capabilities.
Do not add EverRun-specific repository fields to the canonical model.
Do not infer authority from intent text, planner prose, model identity, or successful execution.
invariants: Depends on: 8027.document-dogfood-operations. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Authority is scoped to actor + action + target + authority source/evidence.
Observed action target remains distinct from requested/intended target.
Missing authority evidence is unknown, not allow.
contracts: Authority projection consumes only normalized evidence / ExecutionProjection inputs.
Generic target identity may represent repository, filesystem scope, API resource, tenant object, MCP resource, or other producer-defined target without source-specific core fields.
failure_semantics: Explicit evidence that action target is outside granted/requested authority emits authority_violation with evidence refs.
Insufficient authority evidence emits authority_unknown only when an authority claim/evaluation is required by observed evidence; it must not become authority_ok.

steps.title: Project authority facts
details: Add the smallest AuthorityRecord shape required to retain actor, action, observed target, optional requested target, authority source/native value, and evidence refs.
Keep producer-specific target details in source payload/details rather than new universal fields.

steps.title: Detect explicit authority violations
details: Emit authority_violation only from explicit mismatch/denial/out-of-scope evidence.
Required regression: requested project/target A plus observed write target B plus evidence that B is outside scope => authority_violation.

steps.title: Preserve authority unknown
details: When evidence proves an authority check is required but its result is absent/indeterminate, emit authority_unknown or preserve unknown state.

steps.title: Prove framework neutrality
details: Tests include one repository-target case and one non-repository generic resource case.
Core logic must not branch on source == everrun.

acceptance: Authority projection preserves requested/observed target distinction when evidence provides both.
Explicit cross-target unauthorized action produces authority_violation with evidence refs.
Missing authority evidence never becomes allow/clean.
No EverRun-specific source branch is introduced.
Existing policy-gate runtime behavior remains unchanged.
validate: python -m ruff check src/ailuros/projection.py src/ailuros/signals.py tests/test_authority_governance.py

must_check: Authority is evidence-backed and scoped to actor/action/target.
Requested intent and observed target remain distinct.
Repository case is implemented without repository-specific core taxonomy.
Unknown authority is not treated as allow.
reject_if: A runtime authorization API, RBAC, IAM, policy DSL, or write interceptor is added.
Authority is inferred from planner/model prose or successful execution.
source == everrun or equivalent source-specific governance branch is introduced.
Missing authority evidence is interpreted as clean/allowed.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Authority projection and signal regression over repository and generic resource evidence.
